evidence.quote: Bulk RNA-seq samples with corresponding expression data were obtained from ORIEN and TCGA. Samples from TCGA were identified and downloaded using the R package {GenomicDataCommons} and restricted to samples from patients’ primary tumors. TC

Bulk RNA-seq samples with corresponding expression data were obtained from ORIEN and TCGA. Samples from TCGA were identified and downloaded using the R package {GenomicDataCommons} and restricted to samples from patients’ primary tumors. TC

From here, the R package {decontam} was used to identify contaminants within ORIEN and TCGA samples ( 12 ). These contaminant lists were revised using the literature-reviewed list from Poore and colleagues before contaminants were removed f

notes: Pan-cancer dataset also includes colorectal/bladder tumours, which are ineligible. Conservatively retain Streptomyces explicitly linked to KIRC/LUAD and Fusobacterium explicitly detected in non-colorectal tumours. Other named genera only pooled across eligible/ineligible types and not assigned to eligible tissue in text; no converted supplements available. 16S validation is additional, method reflects primary RNA-seq mining.
